test: accroche scène-constat sans question (0-3,5 s) ; appel au partage en scène finale

scenes.prompt: In a cozy French living room on a Sunday afternoon, a child aged 8 sprawled on the sofa stares at a glowing tablet with a blank glowing screen, another child aged 9 holds a game controller in front of a dark television, a father stands in the doorway holding up his hand with five fingers spread, amused and slightly exasperated expression, a wall clock, warm lamp light.

scenes.surtitre: ET ÇA DURE DEPUIS CE MATIN…
scenes.prompt: Inside a cozy French home: a tired but smiling mother sits at the kitchen table with a mug of tea, sighing, while in the background three children aged 7 to 10 sit in a row on the sofa all lit by the glow of screens, a tablet, a handheld console and a television, a sleepy cat on the armrest, toys untouched in a basket.

Three children aged 7 to 10 dressed as little knights with cardboard armor, golden paper crowns and a helmet with a red plume, running joyfully through a charming Alsatian street with half-timbered houses and flower boxes, one holding an old treasure map, another a big magnifying glass, a smiling parent following behind.

Children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with paper crowns and a red plumed helmet gather around a stone fountain in a flowered Alsatian square with half-timbered houses, reading a rolled parchment clue together, one pointing at a carved stone detail with a magnifying glass, a parent crouching beside them, curious and happy.

Laughing children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet open a small wooden treasure chest glowing with golden light in a cobbled Alsatian lane with half-timbered houses and red geraniums, parents laughing and clapping behind them, late afternoon golden light.

A kind old wise man with a long white beard and a burgundy cloak knights a proud child aged 8 wearing a paper crown and cardboard armor with a wooden sword, in a flowered Alsatian street with half-timbered houses, other children knights cheering, an open treasure chest with golden coins, parents smiling.
